mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_call_record ( conversation_id, turn_id, task_id, provider_request_id, call_type, agent_step_no, attempt_no, status, apply_status, provider_code, route_id, api_protocol, model_name, estimated_input_tokens, input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens, cached_input_tokens, total_tokens, context_window, max_output_tokens, history_end_turn_no, compression_end_turn_no, is_anchor_reusable, summary_version, context_version, context_fingerprint, system_prompt_version, system_prompt_hash, tool_definition_version, tool_schema_hash, compression_level, latency_millis, error_code, error_message ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{taskId}, #{providerRequestId}, #{callType}, #{agentStepNo}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{applyStatus}, #{providerCode}, #{routeId}, #{apiProtocol}, #{modelName}, #{estimatedInputTokens}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{reasoningTokens}, #{cachedInputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{contextWindow}, #{maxOutputTokens}, #{historyEndTurnNo}, #{compressionEndTurnNo}, #{anchorReusable}, #{summaryVersion}, #{contextVersion}, #{contextFingerprint}, #{systemPromptVersion}, #{systemPromptHash}, #{toolDefinitionVersion}, #{toolSchemaHash}, #{compressionLevel}, #{latencyMillis}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage} )
